title: 'Computational studies on coumestrol-ArlR interaction to target ArlRS signaling cascade involved in MRSA virulence'.
authors: Verma, Abhishek Kumar; Jaiswal, Grijesh; Sultana, Kazi Nasrin; Srivastava, Sandeep Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算模拟研究植物化合物coumestrol与MRSA响应调控因子ArlR的相互作用，抑制其二聚化以阻断下游DNA结合，属于蛋白质-DNA互作上游调控机制的计算研究，但未直接建模TF-DNA结合，方法为分子模拟，可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Two component signaling system ArlRS (Autolysis-related locus) regulates adhesion, biofilm formation and virulence in methicillin resistant Staphylococcus aureus. It consists of a histidine kinase ArlS and response regulator ArlR. ArlR is composed of a N-terminal receiver domain and DNA-binding effector domain at C-terminal. ArlR receiver domain dimerizes upon signal recognition and activates DNA binding by effector domain and subsequent virulence expression. In silico simulation and structural data suggest that coumestrol, a phytochemical found in Pueraria montana, forges a strong intermolecular interaction with residues involved in dimer formation and destabilizes ArlR dimerization, an essential conformational switch required for downstream effector domain to bind to virulent loci. Structural and energy profiles of simulated ArlR-coumestrol complexes suggest lower affinity between ArlR monomers due to structural rigidity at the dimer interface hindering the conformational rearrangements relevant for dimer formation. These analyses could be an attractive strategy to develop therapeutics and potent leads molecules response regulators of two component systems in which are involved in MRSA virulence as well as other drug-resistant pathogens.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 双组分信号系统ArlRS（自溶相关位点）调控耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌的黏附、生物膜形成及毒力。该系统由组氨酸激酶ArlS和反应调节因子ArlR组成。ArlR由N端接收结构域和C端DNA结合效应结构域构成。ArlR接收结构域在信号识别后发生二聚化，并激活效应结构域对DNA的结合及随后的毒力表达。计算机模拟和结构数据表明，香豆雌酚（coumestrol）——一种存在于葛根（Pueraria montana）中的植物化学物质——与参与二聚化形成的残基建立强分子间相互作用，并 destabilizes ArlR二聚化，而该二聚化是下游效应结构域结合毒力位点所必需的关键构象开关。模拟的ArlR-香豆雌酚复合物的结构和能量特征表明，由于二聚界面处的结构刚性阻碍了与二聚化形成相关的构象重排，ArlR单体之间的亲和力降低。这些分析可能为开发针对MRSA及其他耐药病原体中参与毒力的双组分系统反应调节因子的治疗药物和高效先导分子提供有吸引力的策略。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
